# ci-diagnose agent

Fullsend custom agent that diagnoses failing **Konflux** CI checks on GitHub
pull requests for [KONFLUX-14506](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/KONFLUX-14506).

## Role

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Role | `ci-diagnose` |
| Slug | `konflux-ci-diagnose` |
| Forge | GitHub (`forge.github`) |
| Inference | Google Cloud Vertex AI |
| Harness | [`harness/ci-diagnose.yaml`](../harness/ci-diagnose.yaml) |
| Prompt | [`agents/ci-diagnose.md`](../agents/ci-diagnose.md) |
| Result schema | [`schemas/ci-diagnose-result.schema.json`](../schemas/ci-diagnose-result.schema.json) |

## Behavior

1. **Pre-script** collects PR failing-check context into `check-context.json`
2. **Agent** filters Konflux checks, diagnoses failures, classifies
   `flaky` / `infra` / `code` / `unknown`, writes validated JSON
3. **Post-script** posts a PR comment and may re-run flaky checks within a
   retry budget (`MAX_FLAKE_RETRIES`, default `1`; confidence ≥ `0.7`)

The agent never posts comments or re-runs checks itself (Fullsend sandbox
security model). LLM inference uses Vertex AI credentials delivered via
`host_files`.

## Triggers (planned)

- Slash command on a PR (e.g. `/ci-diagnose` or `/diagnose`)
- Optional later: auto-run on Konflux check failure for enrolled repos

Event wiring lives in the Konflux org/repo `.fullsend` config after registration.
